components.reason: Already canonical in TwelveSixDecoder; let PyTorch select maintained attention kernels instead of adding a custom attention kernel.
Already integrated; do not create a private tensor serialization format.
Reuse maintained benchmark tasks, metrics, aggregation and evaluator orchestration. 12-6 supplies only verified checkpoint inference/logits.
Existing D03 code already targets 0.10.0. Replace future custom scale dedup/filter/executor work with actual maintained DataTrove execution after a purpose-specific hash lock is added.
Existing D04 experiment harness already targets maintained BPE/Unigram. Do not implement BPE or Unigram training algorithms privately.
Use Parquet/Arrow streaming for larger corpus shards rather than designing a project-specific storage layer. Active packing work already owns this seam.
Use native sharding and tensor placement primitives; do not create a private distributed training framework.
Use DCP for sharded scale checkpoints while preserving 12-6 semantic manifest and checkpoint identity.

Reuse maintained scale patterns where they fit, but do not replace the current trainer until TwelveSixDecoder satisfies the required model/config/parallelization interfaces and parity is demonstrated.
Use an adapter/export boundary for ecosystem compatibility; never load foreign pretrained Base weights into canonical 12-6.
Prefer a maintained vLLM adapter/plugin once checkpoint/tokenizer/model mapping is proven instead of building a private GPU serving engine.
Use maintained filesystem/object-store abstraction rather than custom S3/local transport.
Current PyTorch SDPA already dispatches maintained optimized kernels where supported. Add a separate dependency only if measurements show a material uncovered bottleneck.
Would duplicate PyTorch/TorchTitan/Megatron-class infrastructure and slow scale progression.
Use lm-eval for standard external benchmarks; retain only project-specific exact-candidate gates and identity checks.
